description.en:
PHYBOT M1 is a full-size humanoid combining the company's own actuation, control and power systems with learned movement policies. Its architecture is intended for research and for exploring physical work in production, logistics and specialized environments. Reinforcement and imitation learning are part of the manufacturer's described control approach.

The current product page lists more than 32 degrees of freedom, excluding configurable dexterous hands, and a dual-battery arrangement that supports replacing one battery while the other remains installed. PHYBOT identifies its published performance values as laboratory measurements, so real task results depend on configuration, load and operating conditions.
